pages.heading: What did Cbear spot?
pages.alt: Cbear notices a little sausage roll beside his feet, near a puddle.

pages.heading: The roll says hello.
pages.alt: The sausage roll looks at Cbear and speaks to him.

pages.heading: Up it goes!
pages.alt: The sausage roll hops into the air while Cbear watches.

pages.heading: Into the puddle!
pages.alt: The sausage roll lands in the puddle and sends up a splash.

pages.heading: Still smiling.
pages.alt: The sausage roll is wet but smiling beside the puddle, and Cbear smiles too.
